parts.name: sheep
sources: Quaternius, Farm Animals Pack: Sheep.fbx (from https://opengameart.org/content/lowpoly-animated-farm-animal-pack), to glTF by scripts/fbx_gltf.exs. CC0 1.0
A Suffolk sheep: a large sheep with white wool and no horns, a black face and black legs free of wool; a ewe is about 74 cm at the withers.

Wikipedia, Suffolk sheep (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Suffolk_sheep): "The Suffolk is a large sheep, white-woolled and polled, with a black face and black legs free of wool." The infobox: a ewe 74 cm and 88 kg, a ram 80 cm and 125 kg.
The colors and the numbers of the shape: a guess from photos of Suffolk sheep.
